preview.prompt: THEME 01 "薄荷花园" / MINT GARDEN. A sophisticated living botanical workbench, current system reimagined with more finesse. Palette pale pistachio/mint sidebar, warm alabaster workspace, ivory cards, deep pine typography, vivid tangerine actions. Sidebar softly translucent frosted glass with very faint botanical silhouettes behind; selected menu has slender orange rail and elegant underline, not bulky tabs. Fine mint-gray table rules, softly rounded 8px cards, natural very soft shadows. Beautiful lower-left micro-diorama: orange orb tilts with a playful curious gaze, physically lifting a delicate sage-green leaf like a tiny hat from a curved twig; a few cream-white bell flowers, real thin leaf veins, translucency and subtle surface variation, pebble/contact shadow; designed as a convincing interactive 3D component, not a pasted flat sticker. Quiet morning daylight, refined organic materials, extraordinarily cohesive and practical. Include a tiny subdued "01 · 薄荷花园" skin indicator in top toolbar. No gradients covering business content.
